single.rationale: Intuitive Surgical demonstrates exceptional fundamental performance with 20.5% revenue growth, expanding margins (29.3% operating), and strong cash generation ($2.5B FCF). However, the valuation is extremely rich at 63x P/E and 72x P/FCF, pricing in sustained excellence. The company faces meaningful risks from tariffs, competitive pressures, and execution challenges with new product launches (da Vinci 5, SP, Ion), warranting monitoring before deeper commitment.
